name: Goushen
body:
The goushen are canine humanoids tracing their heritage to the loyal celestial dogs that served the early emperors and guardian spirits of the Celestial Heavens. Vigilant, alert, and bound by martial honor, they make natural sentinels, magistrates, and stalwart guardians.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Goushen are perceptive and physically agile, but tend to be blunt and stubborn. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, and -2 Charisma.
Type: Humanoid (canine). Goushen are humanoids with the canine subtype.
Size: Medium. Goushen have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Speed: Normal. Goushen have a base land speed of 30 feet.
Languages: Goushen begin play speaking Common. Those with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Celestial, Draconic, Goblin, Orc, and Sylvan.
Senses and Defense Racial Traits
Low-Light Vision: Goushen can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Scent (Ex): Goushen possess the scent special ability.
Vigilant Watcher: Goushen receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against sleep, paralysis, and illusion effects.
Offense and Skill Racial Traits
Bite Attack: A goushen gains a natural bite attack that deals 1d4 points of piercing damage (plus Strength modifier).
Keen Senses: Goushen gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Survival checks.
Coordinated Tactics: When fighting adjacent to an ally, goushen gain a +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class.
